title: Machine register state
statement: A machine state is an assignment of a natural number to each of eighteen registers: the input-length counter; the base $|x|+2$; the exponent counter and power accumulator; a scratch register and the copy-and-shift scratch register; a loop counter; the window radius; the code width (the recursion depth) and its bound $2^w$; the source and target codes of the current node; its midpoint and level; the stack of saved endpoints, whose digits have width $w$; the stack of phase bits; the last popped endpoint; and a scratch register for the pop routine.
